[[File:PentarQuote.jpg|right]] Part of the unique feel of [[Planescape]] was its inclusion of in-world quotes mixed in with game text, typically presented in the [[Exocet]] font. When Planescape returned in 5th Edition, these quotes were instead presented alongside a [[mimir]] graphic, implying the mimir is repeating the quote. == 2nd Edition == {| class="article-table sortable" |+ Caption ! Quote !! Speaker !! Speaker Info !! Source !! Reference? |- | So you made it, eh? And now you think you're tough 'cause you can cast some spells and fly around on your [[silver cord]]? Well, I got news, you berk, I live out here and I was born tough, so why don't you just fly back home, eh? || [[Tavis]] the Reaver || 's greeting to an Astral traveler in [[Sigil]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 2 || |- | It all depends on where you stand. || [[Marat-thon]] || , [[Sign of One|Signer]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 3 || |- | Barren? Yes, but no one crosses the [[Astral Plane|silver void]] without our knowledge. || [[Sivisk Imchal]] || , [[githyanki]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 6 || |- | [[Waterdeep]]? Never heard of it. || [[Factol]] [[Pentar]] || , [[Doomguard]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 8 || A reply to the quote on p. 31. |- | [[Mechanus]]? My home. It's a great place — everybody knows what their role is. || [[Factol]] [[Hashkar]] || , [[Fraternity of Order|Guvner]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 8 || |- | Gods protect us from the boredom that is [[Mechanus]]! || [[Factol]] [[Karan]] || , [[Xaositects|Chaosman]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 10 || |- | Better to wrestle with a giant than to lock horns with a [[bariaur]]. || [[Ysgard]]ian proverb || || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 11 || |- | [[Githzerai]], [[githyanki]], who cares? They're all the same. || The late [[Yufan Lis]] || The late Yufan Lis || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 12 || |- | Don't ever make a bet with a tiefling. || Planar proverb || || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 13 || |- | I'm dead? So why don't I remember dying? || [[Al-Jaffar]] || , formberly of [[Huzuz]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 13 || |- | Hey, you berk! If the gods really were alive and cared, do you think you'd be here? || [[Factol]] [[Terrance]] || of the [[Athar]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 16 || |- | We are all one — gods, mortals, even fiends come from the same source. Who knows? Maybe next time you'll be a [[larva]]. || [[Factol]] [[Ambar]] || , of the [[Believers of the Source|Godsmen]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 17 || |- | Hear the barmies howling in the [[Maze]]s? If you're here to learn the secrets of the [[multiverse]], you might as well save yourself some time and go join 'em, 'cause that's all it means — that and nothing else. || [[Factol]] [[Lhar]] || of the [[Bleak Cabal]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 18 || |- | Everything decays, we're just here to help it along. || [[Factol]] [[Pentar]] || of the [[Doomguard]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 19 || |- | The planes are governed by laws, laws can be learned, learn the laws and you rule the [[multiverse]]. That is our goal. || [[Factol]] [[Hashkar]] || of the [[Fraternity of Order|Guvner]]s || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 22 || |- | Sod off! I don't need your mumbo-jumbo. || [[Karris]] || , an [[Free League|Indep]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 23 || |- | Do it our way or no way, understand that, berk? || [[Factol]] [[Sarin]] || of the [[Harmonium]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 24 || |- | Where's the center of the [[multiverse]]? It's me — I'm the center of the multivese. || [[Factol]] [[Darius]] || of the [[Sign of One|Signers]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 27 || |- | Touch it. Smell it. Taste it. See it. Hit it. || [[Factol]] [[Erin Darkflame Montgomery|Erin]] || of the [[Society of Sensation|Sensates]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 28 || |- | By the time you've thought about it, I'll have killed you. That makes it a do-or-die deal. || [[Factol]] [[Rhys]] || of the [[Transcendent Order|Ciphers]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 29 || |- | Beautiful is! Chaos too dim multiverse. Is to notice most the of. || [[Factol]] [[Karan]] || of the [[Xaositects|Chaosmen]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 30 || |- | Hey, is this [[Waterdeep]]? || [[Rking]] || of [[Faerun]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 31 || The answer is found in a quote on page 8.
Rking is probably a reference to author [[w:c:forgottenrealms:J. Robert King|J. Robert King]]. |- | Looking for the [[Xaositects|Xaositect]]'s faction headquarters, [[clueless]]? Come with me — you're under arrest. || [[Minnith]] || , a [[Harmonium]] officer || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A Player's Guide to the Planes'', p. 32 || |- | Pike it, berk! I'm [[Thor]]'s [[proxy]], and your laws don't apply to me. || [[Franok Heiden]] || Last words of Franok Heiden, to a [[Mercykiller]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A DM Guide to the Planes'', p. 6 || |- | I ain't barmy! Don't ever call me barmy or I'll nick you — got that? || A resident of [[Pandemonium]] || || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A DM Guide to the Planes'', p. 7 || |- | You figure a sword and a bunch of spells make you tough? It ain't what you got that counts, berk, it's what you know. || [[Fairven]] || , a [[Transcendent Order|Cipher]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A DM Guide to the Planes'', p. 13 || |- | Doubt? We do not question. We do. || [[Tricalus]] || [[Modron]] Tricalus || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A DM Guide to the Planes'', p. 14 || |- | We're marooned in [[Baator]], you've lost the [[gate key]], a dozen [[pit fiend]]s are headed this way, the paladin is down and might be dead, and your [[power key]]'s a fake — so what? || [[Hortaz]] || of the [[Bleak Cabal]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A DM Guide to the Planes'', p. 16 || |- | The noble, best, and true [[petitioner]]s in [[Sigil]] are those who turn and listen when they hear sweet trumpets sounding. || [[Isab]] || [[Deva]] Isab of the Bent Wing || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A DM Guide to the Planes'', p. 17 || |- | Everything decays, we're just here to help it along. || [[Factol]] [[Pentar]] || of the [[Doomguard]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A DM Guide to the Planes'', p. 19 || |- | You ever traveled the [[Great Road]] and seen the madness out there, leatherhead? Try it, and then tell me it all means something. || [[Phaal]] || Caravan-Master Phaal of the [[Bleak Cabal]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A DM Guide to the Planes'', p. 22 || |- | Where do I go to see the [[Blood War]]? || Anonymous [[Clueless]] || || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A DM Guide to the Planes'', p. 23 || |- | The beauty of a [[spell key]] is that it's a secret of the [[multiverse]] that fits in yer pocket. || [[Pargette]] || the Apprentice || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''

''A DM Guide to the Planes'', p. 28 || |- | Artists are engineers of the soul. That's why we lock them up. || [[Tall Tally]] || of the [[Mercykillers]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A DM Guide to the Planes'', p. 37 || |- | Shut your yap, [[Clueless]]. You'll be rotting quietly soon enough anyway. || Anonymous [[Doomguard]] || || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A DM Guide to the Planes'', p. 38 || |- | Course I know how to talk to a zombie! But I just got in from the [[Negative Energy plane|Neg' Energy Plane]], and I'm just plain sick of talking to cold folks, okay? || [[Rahm]] || , a [[bariaur]] [[Revolutionary League|Anarchist]], peeling his way through the [[Mortuary]] || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
''A DM Guide to the Planes'', p. 39 || |- | I ain't barmy! Don't ever call me barmy or I'll nick you — got that? || A resident of [[Pandemonium]] || || ''[[Planescape Campaign Setting]]''
